name: cs-navigator
description: Route capability-selection questions using verifiable trust, freshness, permissions, execution evidence, and the smallest useful set.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator 0.7.0 RC2 routes capability-selection questions using current verifiable-trust evidence, freshness, permissions, security findings, Risk Labels, and known gaps while keeping ordinary direct tasks with ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Tell me whether this task needs a skill or ChatGPT can handle it directly.
Find the smallest useful CS capability for this goal and show the material trust or permission trade-off.
Check whether this skill is current, tested, and appropriate for the permissions this task requires.
